name: walletmv-app
description: WalletMV phone app for Android and iPhone, built with Capacitor from the WalletMV website

scripts.setup: npm run sync-web && npx cap add android && npx capacitor-assets generate --android
scripts.setup-ios: npm run sync-web && npx cap add ios && npx capacitor-assets generate --ios
scripts.build: npm run sync-web && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run build && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run build && npx cap open ios
